prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a passenger and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1303; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2 entered from a cross street and struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was present at the scene, as confirmed by both drivers and two independent witnesses. Passenger reported a concussion and complained of head pain and dizziness; the nature of the impact and the way the occupant's body moved inside the vehicle are consistent with that complaint. Witnesses, scene photographs and Driver 2's own statement all agree on the sequence of events as described by Driver 1. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with a broadside impact of this type. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle is known to officers or to Driver 1. Both drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles were removed from the roadway by tow operators.
